metadata.title: Enterprise AI Microservice Mock Fixtures & RBAC Testing Schema
metadata.description: Comprehensive mock API responses, RBAC permission matrices, and secure inter-service HTTP client templates for .NET 8 Web API & Gateway microservices.
metadata.author: Antigravity .NET 8 Security Expert
standards: RFC 7807 Problem Details for HTTP APIs

Admin.description: Tenant Administrator with complete administrative privileges across tenant data, user provisioning, security policies, and unconstrained classification clearance.

Researcher.description: Primary analytical user capable of querying AI models, executing research workflows, uploading documents, and accessing up to Confidential tier information.

Viewer.description: Standard read-only user restricted strictly to public and standard internal documentation. Expressly barred from Confidential and Restricted tiers.
Viewer.strictBoundaryNotes: Standard users receive 403 Forbidden when attempting access to Confidential documents.

ServicePrincipal.description: Automated inter-service machine-to-machine identity authenticating via mTLS and OAuth2 Client Credentials grant.

Public.description: Public tenant information accessible to any authenticated principal.

Internal.description: Standard business operations data accessible to all verified employees and contractors.

Confidential.description: Proprietary research, intellectual property, financial projections, and model weights. Standard viewers are prohibited.

Restricted.description: Strict executive, legal M&A, cryptographic keys, and system diagnostics. Tenant administrators only.

ai-service.description: Deep learning inference, autonomous agent execution, and dense embeddings generation.

document-processor.description: Asynchronous document OCR, format transformation, layout analysis, and chunk extraction.

vector-database-cluster.description: High-throughput vector indexing, HNSW cosine similarity search, and payload filtering.

notification-service.description: Transactional emails, Slack webhooks, and push notifications with dead-letter queueing.

billing-service.description: Usage aggregation, quota enforcement, and stripe subscription metering.

delegatingHandlers.purpose: Extracts the incoming Authorization header from current HttpContext and forwards it downstream to preserve caller claims and identity context.
Ensures the X-Tenant-ID header and tenant claim are injected into all inter-service requests for continuous multi-tenant boundary isolation.
Propagates or generates X-Correlation-ID for end-to-end distributed tracing across microservice boundaries.
Attaches the enterprise x509 client certificate to primary TLS handshake for zero-trust service mesh authentication.

rfc7807_400_BadRequest.title: One or more validation errors occurred in the request payload.
rfc7807_400_BadRequest.detail: Refer to the errors property for individual field validation constraints.

Email: The Email field is not a valid e-mail address.
Password: The Password field must be at least 8 characters long.

rfc7807_401_Unauthorized.title: Unauthorized
rfc7807_401_Unauthorized.detail: Missing, invalid, or expired JWT Bearer token in Authorization header.

rfc7807_403_Forbidden_ConfidentialCleara.title: Forbidden: Insufficient Classification Clearance
rfc7807_403_Forbidden_ConfidentialCleara.detail: Access Denied: Standard users (Viewer role) cannot access 'Confidential' tier documents.

rfc7807_403_Forbidden_CrossTenant.title: Forbidden: Multi-Tenant Boundary Violation
rfc7807_403_Forbidden_CrossTenant.detail: Cross-tenant access attempt strictly denied. User tenant does not match resource tenant.

rfc7807_404_NotFound.title: Resource Not Found
rfc7807_404_NotFound.detail: The requested entity identifier does not exist within your tenant boundary.

rfc7807_429_TooManyRequests.title: Too Many Requests
rfc7807_429_TooManyRequests.detail: API Gateway rate limit exceeded. Please back off and retry after the replenishment period.

rfc7807_503_ServiceUnavailable.title: Service Unavailable: Circuit Breaker Open
rfc7807_503_ServiceUnavailable.detail: The downstream 'ai-service' is experiencing transient failure; circuit is currently Open.
